claims.claim: PCA components are orthogonal directions ordered by explained variance in the centered training data.
claims.notes: PCA does not automatically standardize features to unit variance.

claims.claim: t-SNE focuses on preserving local neighborhood similarities and does not make plotted global distances or cluster sizes directly interpretable.
claims.locator: scikit-learn t-SNE guide: local structure, stochastic optimization and limits on global geometry
claims.notes: Embedding shape and appearance can vary with perplexity, initialization, seed and sample.

claims.claim: TargetEncoder.fit_transform uses internal cross-fitting; fit(X,y).transform(X) can leak target information into training representations.
claims.notes: Default random folds may be inappropriate for temporal or grouped data.

claims.claim: Supervised feature selection must be fitted within each training fold to avoid using validation or test targets.
claims.notes: Feature selection and hyperparameter choices are part of the learned procedure.
